title: The Windows build ships again
highlights: Nothing has changed for users since 0.10.4. This release exists because 0.10.4 published without its Windows binaries, and because a release should be reproducible from its own tag
improvements: Windows x86_64 is published again, through the release pipeline rather than by hand
fixes: The release pipeline withheld the Windows x86_64 binary whenever the Windows ARM64 build failed: both were packaged in a single step that stopped at the first missing file, and the run still reported success
Windows ARM64 still does not build, so this release ships every platform except that one
